sourceDetail: Cabin geometry (number, deck, raw x/y, fill colour) parsed from deckmaps.com versioned deck SVGs (/data/out/royal-caribbean/quantum-of-the-seas/v2457/deck-<N>.<hash>.svg), one .cabinShape[data-cabin] element per stateroom (rect, polygon, or path). Category legend built by matching each fill colour to Royal Caribbean stateroom categories, verified per-colour against cruisedeckplans.com category-detail and stateroom-details pages and cross-checked against exact category counts.

notes.completeness: FULL grid: every stateroom on every guest deck (decks 3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12,13). Decks 4,5,14,15,16 carry no staterooms in the source. deckmaps advertised total for this ship is 2098 and every deck matches its per-deck count exactly (3:106, 6:192, 7:239, 8:276, 9:277, 10:287, 11:267, 12:235, 13:219). cruisedeckplans category total is ~2095 and Royal Caribbean markets ~2090; the small surplus is the multi-deck loft suites, which deckmaps draws once per deck they span (Royal/Owner/Sky/Grand Loft each appear on two deck plans, so e.g. Royal Loft 8320 is counted on both deck 8 and deck 9).
notes.category: deckmaps encodes category only via cabin fill colour. 29 distinct fills map to 12 Royal Caribbean marketed categories (several categories use more than one colour shade). Every fill was tied to a category either by a named representative cabin on cruisedeckplans (e.g. 7232=Junior Suite Large Balcony, 7230=Interior/Virtual Balcony, 8320=Royal Loft, 8720=Owner Loft, 8722/10322=Sky Loft, 10320/10324/10720/10724=Grand Loft, 8106/9110/11110=Oceanview, 8512/10556/10300=Balcony) or, for the three high-count balcony/interior shades, by inboard-vs-outboard row geometry cross-checked against category counts. See colorLegend. Known soft spot: Interior vs Ocean View differ by +8/-8 against cruisedeckplans (deckmaps colours ~8 inboard cabins as interior that cruisedeckplans counts as oceanview); every other category matches within +/-2.
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic. Per deck the length axis is Y and the bow is at low Y (confirmed on every deck: lowest-numbered staterooms sit at low Y). section = forward/mid/aft equal thirds of the deck length. Approximate.
notes.side: DERIVED heuristic. Per deck the beam axis is X and the plans are drawn bow-up, so lower X is the port beam. Cabins are rank-split about the per-deck X median: the lower-X half is labelled port, the higher-X half starboard (near 50/50 per deck). The forward hull decks (8-11) fan out and the inboard/outboard rows are not perfectly separable, so a few near-centreline cabins may be mis-sided. Could also be uniformly mirrored if deckmaps flips a plan; validate against a known cabin before relying on it.
notes.obstructed: deckmaps SVGs carry no obstructed-view flag; obstructed=false for all (source does not encode obstruction, not asserted as clear-view). Separately, cruisedeckplans flags cabins such as 6254/6258/6654/6658/7254/7258/7654/7658 as obstructed; that is not reflected here.
